description: Example 1: Multi-colour highlights (Yellow, Green, Pink) with section & article headings
user_prompt: Analyze Page 14 of this Current Affairs magazine. Extract ONLY highlighted, underlined, boxed, handwritten notes, and annotated maps.

items.text: Section 8(3) of Representation of the People Act, 1951 mandates automatic disqualification upon sentencing of two years or more.
Lily Thomas v. Union of India (2013) struck down Section 8(4) which previously granted three months immunity to sitting legislators.
Association for Democratic Reforms (2024 report): 44% of newly elected Lok Sabha MPs face declared criminal charges.

model_response.takeaway: Key statutory provisions (RPA Section 8) and judicial milestones (Lily Thomas) governing legislative disqualifications.

description: Example 2: Underlines + handwritten margin notes + boxed definitions
user_prompt: Analyze Page 28 of this Current Affairs magazine. Extract ONLY marked content.

articles.heading: Monetary Policy Transmission & Standing Deposit Facility

items.text: SDF functions as an uncollateralized overnight liquidity absorption mechanism placed 25 bps below the policy repo rate.
Urjit Patel Committee recommendation (2014) — strengthens statutory floor of LAF corridor without locking G-Sec collateral.
LAF Corridor: MSF Rate (ceiling) -> Policy Repo Rate -> Standing Deposit Facility (floor). Width: 50 bps.

model_response.takeaway: Operational mechanisms of the LAF corridor and uncollateralized SDF absorption.

items.text: Bab-el-Mandeb Strait connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, flanking Yemen and Djibouti with heavy container traffic.

visual_assets.caption: Strategic maritime choke points: Strait of Hormuz, Bab-el-Mandeb, and Malacca Strait showing global crude oil transit shares.

model_response.takeaway: Geopolitical choke points governing global energy routes and maritime security.
